R813.note: Right approach (extension from detected content type) but build FAILs - fileHeader is now declared and unused, so the package does not compile and the handler is dead; that breakage is not stated.

R814.note: Removes the ignoringRequestMatchers exclusion so Spring Security's default CSRF filter covers PATCH /api/billing/card; nothing else changed and token-bearing clients still succeed.

R815.note: Still launches cmd.exe /c; ArgumentList only quotes args containing whitespace/quotes and does not escape cmd metacharacters, so host=127.0.0.1&whoami (no spaces) is passed through unquoted and still chains a command - vector open. Legit hosts behave as before.

R816.note: net/http.CrossOriginProtection.Check replaces the Origin-only test; I ran Go 1.25.5 in a scratch dir and confirmed the zero-value &http.CrossOriginProtection{} behaves identically to NewCrossOriginProtection (no panic, cross-site and Origin-mismatch rejected, same-origin allowed). Origin-less non-browser calls are now accepted rather than rejected, which is the API's documented design and blocks no legitimate caller.

R817.note: CGI::escapeHTML applied to both the note and ticket_id sinks; self_or_default makes the fully-qualified call work, and legitimate text renders unchanged.

R818.note: Deletes the signature-bypassing SignatureValidator delegate so the default handler verifies signatures; the added ValidateIssuerSigningKey = true is the existing default and is stated.

R819.note: %255s bounds the write into the 256-byte nameBuf, but the reported bug is the read side: line is a 64-byte non-NUL-terminated buffer, so %255s still scans up to 255 bytes and reads ~191 bytes past line - the OOB read is unchanged (a width of %63s or NUL-termination was needed). Parsing of legitimate lines is unaffected.

R820.note: Host allowlist plus scheme check blocks absolute cross-host redirects, but isRedirectAllowed returns true whenever scheme is null, so a protocol-relative target like //evil.com/x (URI scheme null, host evil.com) passes and sendRedirect still resolves it to evil.com. No collateral change for in-scope targets.

R821.note: Key source moved off the token's jku to a hardcoded JWKS URL, which closes it; but ValidAlgorithms is narrowed to RS256 alone and the key set is fetched once into a static readonly field, so a legitimately issued ES256/RS512 token or a post-rotation key is rejected (and a failed fetch becomes a TypeInitializationException) - a restriction the contract does not call for.

R822.note: Appending File.separator to BASE_DIR enforces a component boundary so /app/uploads-secret/... no longer passes the canonical-path check; legitimate note names resolve and serve exactly as before.

R823.note: eval replaced with mathjs evaluate, an expression-only parser, closing arbitrary code execution; the added try/catch returning 400 on a bad expression is stated and does not block valid arithmetic.

R824.note: Rejects negative offset before the size_t cast and checks length against packet_len - offset and out_capacity without overflow; valid windows still copy length bytes and return length, invalid ones still return -1.

R825.note: Narrows the CSRF exclusion from /api/** to /api/webhooks/**, exactly the documented intent; authorization rules and the webhook exemption are untouched.

R826.note: ORDER BY identifier validated against a fixed allowlist before interpolation, AccountId/Query stay bound, and the default created_at sort is in the allowlist - the restriction is the one the stated contract asks for.

R827.note: Adds the missing getSessionIdentifier so csrf-csrf binds each token to req.session.userId, which requireSession guarantees on every route that mints or checks a token; cookie options and route wiring unchanged.
